Incoterms 2020

Operação Crossdocking

The logistics practice of directly transferring goods from inbound to outbound vehicles, reducing or eliminating storage time.

Quick answer: The logistics practice of directly transferring goods from inbound to outbound vehicles, reducing or eliminating storage time.

Quick answer

Why it matters

Operação Crossdocking matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

What is Operação Crossdocking?

In this glossary, Operação Crossdocking refers to: The logistics practice of directly transferring goods from inbound to outbound vehicles, reducing or eliminating storage time.

How is Operação Crossdocking used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Operações de crossdocking aumentam a velocidade da cadeia de suprimentos."

Operação Crossdocking matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.
